Interface UpgradedHttpResponse<B>

Type Parameters:
B - The object body type, always empty
All Superinterfaces:
AttributeHolder, AutoCloseable, ByteBodyHttpResponse<B>, Closeable, HttpMessage<B>, HttpResponse<B>, MutableAttributeHolder
public interface UpgradedHttpResponse<B> extends ByteBodyHttpResponse<B>
A 101 Switching Protocols response whose connection now carries another protocol, e.g. WebSocket, in both directions: ByteBodyHttpResponse.byteBody() is what the peer sends after the switch, and send(CloseableByteBody) sends bytes to the peer. The connection is closed when either direction ends or fails, or when the response is closed.

The raw HTTP client returns one when a request that allows upgrades is answered with 101, see RawRequestOptions#isAllowUpgrade(). A route that returns it relays the switched protocol: the server writes the 101, streams ByteBodyHttpResponse.byteBody() to its client and passes the bytes of its client to send(CloseableByteBody).

Since:
5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • send

      void send(CloseableByteBody outbound)
      Send bytes to the peer after the switch. The ownership of the body transfers to the connection, which closes it when it is sent or when the connection is closed. Can be called once.
      Parameters:
      outbound - The bytes to send
